```{r,echo=F}
ds = sample(1:2,1)
if(ds==1){
  d1 = "North"
  d2 = "South"
} else {
  d1 = "East"
  d2 = "West"
}

vv = sample(c(-1,1),1)
xs = sample(1:10,2)

x1 = xs[1]*vv
x2 = xs[2]*vv*(-1)
x3 = x1+x2

M1 = abs(x1)
M2 = abs(x2)
M3 = abs(x3)

if(x1>0){
  D1 = d1
} else {
  D1 = d2
}

if(x2>0){
  D2 = d1
} else {
  D2 = d2
}

if(x3>0){
  D3 = d1
} else if(x3<0) {
  D3 = d2
} else {
  D3 = "directionless"
}

ach1 = 0:20
ach2 = c("North","East","South","West","directionless")

sol1 = paste0(1*(M3==ach1),collapse="")
sol2 = paste0(1*(ach2==D3),collapse="")

al1 = paste0("* ",ach1,collapse="\n")
al2 = paste0("* ",ach2,collapse="\n")


```



Question
========

A box sits on a frictionless surface. A `r M1` newtons force pushes the box towards `r D1`. Simultaneously a `r M2` newtons force pushes the box towards `r D2`.

What is the net force?

##ANSWER1## newtons ##ANSWER2##

Answerlist
--------

`r al1`
`r al2`



Solution
========

The net (resultant) force is `r M3` newtons `r D3`.
